//: Composite indexes for the paginated queries in store.js pageQuery(). The scoped realtime subscriptions (month range only) use single-field indexes that Firestore auto-creates, so they need nothing here. These composites are required when browsing a single supplier's history ordered by month (where supplierId == X, orderBy month desc). Deploy with `firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes`, or click the auto-generated index link Firestore prints in the console the first time such a query runs.
